scripts.audio: npm run cues && python make_audio.py out/cues-show.json out/show-audio.wav
scripts.encode:show-audio: remotion ffmpeg -y -i out/show-4k.mp4 -i out/show-audio.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -vf scale=1920:1080:flags=lanczos,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 17 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/newton-showcase-audio.mp4
scripts.render:site: npm run render:show && npm run encode:show-site
scripts.render:audio: npm run audio && npm run render:show && npm run encode:show-audio && npm run encode:show-site
